about: Lists of the ipset corpus (testdata/ipset.json) that the Core Updater writes differently because it runs the algebra without a placeholder (Placeholder ""). Each row names a corpus case and a list in it, today's list as old_expect and Core's as expect. Run by TestCoreRunsTheCorpusWithoutAPlaceholderAsTheDepartureFixtureSays; the corpus itself keeps today's answers, which the smoke VM replays.
